answer: Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the cedar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
